chunks: 4668 - It was narrated from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, who said:
ʿAlī ibn Shuʿayb wrote to Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: “A woman breastfed one of my children. Is it permissible for me to marry one of her children?”
So he wrote: “That is not permissible, because her children have become like your own children.”

key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the status or legal position of
key_terms.يَجُوزُ: is permissible according to the law

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to marry the child of a woman who breastfed one of your children?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on milk-kinship through breastfeeding. The Imam عليه السلام states that when a woman breastfeeds a child, her children take on the status of the man's own children in terms of marriage prohibition, making such a marriage impermissible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4668 - It was narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh who said:
Ali ibn Shu'ayb wrote to Abu al-Hasan (as) asking: "A woman breastfed one of my children. Is it permissible for me to marry one of her children?"
Imam (as) wrote in response, "That is not permissible because her children have become like your own children."
